text:
liz.sales: Heads-up  BiomedEdge RFP landed. They want a capability matrix + security questionnaire answers + a compact on-prem POC plan. Unique asks: model watermarking, SSE for logs, WAF integration, and HIPAA/HITRUST posture. POC window = 2 weeks (tight). PDF attached.

ethan-se: Tight timeline. Do we have their perf targets? concurrency, avg tokens?

liz.sales: They called out 500 rps bursty, typical prompt 40 tokens, responses ~120 tokens. Latency targets: p50 <= 180ms, p95 <= 450ms. They also insist on proof of watermarking on outputs and encrypted-at-rest logs with customer-side SSE keys.

ethan-se: 500 rps is non-trivial. For dedicated we'd recommend a 4x GPU pool with autoscale headroom. Air-gapped appliance will need a beefier box to hit p95. Watermarking proof requires a deterministic post-processing hook; we'll note a watermarking SDK integration.

noor-ops: Deployment options? They checked both "private VPC" and "appliance (air-gapped)". Also require WAF rules for the ingress and an option for egress-blocked metrics export. For SSE logs: need KMS/HSM customer key integration and local envelope encryption in appliance mode.

rfi-bot: Templates found: /sales/rfps/biomed-template.md. Compliance snapshot: SOC2-TypeII=yes; ISO27001=partial; HITRUST=under-eval; FedRAMP=no; KMS/HSM integration=Y; WAF-integration=supported.

sam-csm: We must lock acceptance criteria up-front given 2-week window. Ask them to specify which of: (1) throughput validation, (2) latency SLOs, (3) watermark verification, (4) SSE logs test are required for pass. Get it in writing.

vivian-legal: We'll need DPA + HIPAA BAA and a bespoke clause for watermarking IP (who owns watermarking scheme) and responsibilities around SSE key custody. Also need clarity on breach notification timelines for offline appliance. I'll draft redline.

ethan-se: Draft capability matrix CSV snippet to include in RFP response (conservative numbers):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,air-gapped
max-rps,2000,5000,800,600
p50-latency,90ms,70ms,160ms,210ms
p95-latency,380ms,260ms,420ms,560ms
watermarking,optional,optional,connector,offline-sdk
sse-logs,managed,customer-kms,connector,customer-envelope
waf-integration,managed,customer-managed,customer-managed,manual-config
data-residency,global,region-pinned,region-pinned,onsite-only
```

liz.sales: Good. Ethan, expand this into a readable table and a 2-page POC runbook for both tracks (install, smoke tests, perf script, watermark verification steps). Noor, include SSE key injection steps and WAF rule example. Vivian, add BAA + watermark IP clause. I'll push kickoff for Fri 08:00 UTC; flag blockers now.

noor-ops: Flag: Appliance build with SSE envelope support + HSM key injection + WAF tuning may take ~8 business days for secure build and validation. With 2-week POC we can do a VPC private track faster; air-gapped might be schedule-risk. Also if they want egress-blocked metrics we need manual metrics export instructions.

ethan-se: Perf note: meeting 500 rps with p95 <= 450ms in air-gapped mode likely needs higher CPU for preprocessing and larger batch config; I'll call out recommended spec and perf risk in the response.

sam-csm: I'll request explicit pass/fail criteria from BiomedEdge PM: include an acceptance form template for them to sign after POC (throughput test results, watermark validation sample, and SSE key rotation test).

vivian-legal: Drafting DPA+BAA redline and a short clause that clarifies watermarking ownership: we propose joint ownership of watermark artifacts; customer retains rights to their data-derived watermarks. Sending to Liz for review.

rfi-bot: Reminder: attach BiomedEdge_RFP_v1.pdf and BiomedEdge_SecQ_v1.pdf. Use /sales/rfps/templates/billing-hook.csv if they want per-token billing during POC.

liz.sales: Thanks. Ethan/Noor/Vivian  please deliver drafts: matrix + runbook + SSE/key injection steps + DPA redline by tomorrow EOD. I'll confirm kickoff time after BiomedEdge confirms acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

ethan-se: Will deliver matrix + runbook. Quick perf script snippet we can include in runbook:
```
# perf test (k6-like pseudocode)
for i in 1..5000:
  send_request(prompt="<sample>", concurrency=500)
measure p50,p95,errors
```

noor-ops: Adding SSE injection example (appliance):
```
# on appliance
sudo inject-key --source /media/usb/cust-kek.pem --dest /var/lib/redwood/kms
sha256sum /media/usb/cust-kek.pem > /var/lib/redwood/kms/manifest.sha256
verify-manifest --keyfile /var/lib/redwood/kms/manifest.sha256
```

liz.sales: Great. One last flag: if they require HITRUST cert before POC, that will be a blocker; we only have HITRUST under evaluation. I'll ask them if HITRUST is mandatory or preferred.

vivian-legal: Noted. I'll add an alternative statement in the DPA acknowledging HITRUST is under evaluation and propose an interim compensating control set.

sam-csm: I'll prepare an acceptance form template and include a short demo checklist (watermark sample verification steps).

liz.sales: All set for now. Uploading attachments and will update once BiomedEdge confirms acceptance criteria. Thanks team.
